punchline: A muscle gets stronger from the tiny damage that lifting does to it, and Taleb says that is how antifragile things work.
thirty_sec: Lift something heavy and the muscle fibres tear slightly. The body repairs them and comes back stronger. Nassim Taleb uses this to explain antifragility, and says the immune system and learning work the same way. The catch is the dose: the stress has to be one you can recover from.
